exceptions.reason: The new core answers upstream errors with an error body it builds itself (message, type and code), not the upstream's JSON passed through; recorded as a deliberate difference when the core skeleton was built.
The new core passes the upstream's Retry-After on to a rate-limited client (RFC 9110 section 10.2.3); today's Kimi path sends none.

The Kimi extension leaves out the device name header: today's core sends the machine's host name, which names the user's computer to Kimi. Kimi's other device headers (platform, version, model, device ID) are still sent.
The Kimi extension names itself in Kimi's device headers (platform pluxy, its own version); today's core names itself CLIProxyAPI with its build version. Neither poses as Kimi's own CLI.
